title: TestPlan
description: The port-less recipe for one test: a named, versioned set of flows with a wall-clock duration. This is what the operator authors (CreateTestRequest.plan) AND what is embedded verbatim into header.json. It is deliberately free of bindings: server-side ports (flow_bindings) and server_host are allocated by test-control and carried alongside the plan in RunTestPayload / header, NOT inside it. The Flow $defs here are the SINGLE source for flow shape across the whole contract.

name.description: Human-readable plan identifier, e.g. "commute_v1". Recorded in header.json. Lowercase, digits, underscores and hyphens so it round-trips through file paths.

version.description: Plan version. Bump when the plan's flow set or per-flow parameters change. Lets analysis distinguish results from different revisions of the same named plan.

duration_sec.description: Total test duration. All flows share this duration; per-flow shorter durations are not modeled in v1.

flows.description: Ordered list of flows. flow_id values MUST be unique within the plan.

Flow.description: Discriminated by `type`. Port-less: the server port for each flow is allocated by test-control and lives in flow_bindings (see run_test_command.schema.json / header.schema.json), keyed by flow_id. gateway_ping flows have no server endpoint and carry no server_port in their binding.

rate_pps.description: Probe send rate. The mobile sends; the server echoes.

packet_size_bytes.description: On-wire UDP payload size. Minimum 22 = ProbePacket v1 header+core (see contracts/packets/probe.md). Padding to a larger size uses trailing zero bytes.

ProbeFlow.description: UDP echo probe. Server-hosted echoer in v1 (UE-hosted echoer would invert invariant 5's initiation flow and is out of scope).

packet_size_bytes.description: On-wire UDP payload size. Minimum 30 = RealtimePacket v1 header+core; remaining bytes are trailing-zero padding.

sndbuf_bytes.description: Sender only (back-pressure test): limit the sending socket's SO_SNDBUF to this many bytes and send non-blocking, so a queue the stack below does not drain shows as EAGAIN in packets.send_status. Omit for the OS default (blocking send).

RealtimeUdpFlow.description: Fixed-rate unidirectional UDP. For Bidirectional traffic, define two flows (one FromServer, one ToServer) with distinct flow_id.

target_bytes.description: Optional byte cap. If omitted, the flow runs until the plan duration elapses.

rate_kbps.description: Optional sending-rate cap in kbit/s of application bytes. The sender writes small chunks (5 ms worth, at most 64 KiB) paced to this rate, so the flow loads the link without filling it. If the path is slower than the cap, the flow runs at the path's rate as uncapped bulk does. Omit for uncapped bulk.

BulkTcpFlow.description: Bulk-throughput TCP. Bidirectional is modeled as two flows on separate connections (remediation 2.2).

profile.description: User model. web: page views (HTML, then 5-120 objects over 6 connections, then 2-90 s reading). mail: a sync every 1-3 min, sometimes an attachment or a sent mail. video: 4 s segments at 1.5/3/5 Mbit/s, three to start, sessions of 1-5 min. social: feed images in bursts with short pauses, now and then a photo upload. mixed: switches between web, social and video every 2-5 min, with mail in the background. agent: an AI agent working through tasks of 1-30 LLM calls; each call sends the whole context up (4-60 kB, growing with every reply and tool result, compacted past 600 kB), waits 0.25-10 s for the first token, then streams the reply (20-3000 tokens at 40-90 tokens/s in 140-B server-sent events); between calls 1-4 parallel tool calls (MCP: ~1 kB up, 0.05-10 s latency, ~4 kB result; web fetch: 0.03-3 s first byte, ~150 kB page); 5-300 s between tasks. websearch: an AI agent answering by web search, each task a graph: an LLM plan call, a search API call, 2-6 page fetches in parallel, an LLM synthesis call that waits for all of them (the pages' text goes up as context), 30 % a second search round; 5-60 s between tasks. script: runs `actions`.

workers.description: Concurrent simulated users, each with its own connections. Default 1; a script runs on one.

seed.description: Seed of the users' choices (default 1): the same seed asks for the same objects in the same order.

scale.description: Multiplies every object size (default 1.0); below 1 saves data, timing behaviour stays.

placement.description: profiles agent and websearch: where the tools run (default device). device: tool calls are phone traffic, and the next LLM call sends their results up with the context. cloud: the LLM provider runs them inside the call (server-side tools); the reply stream pauses for the slowest tool, carries the results' text down (cloud_tool) and resumes with the next turn (llm_resume) without a new request, so the context goes up once per call chain. hybrid: MCP calls on the phone, web fetches in the cloud (websearch: the search in the cloud, the page fetches on the phone). Each resume costs the phone a 44-byte request a real provider would not need (a protocol artifact, outside app_up_bytes).

actions.description: profile script only: the timeline, e.g. written by an AI agent playing a user.

at_ms.description: Start this long after the test starts. Actions run in order; one due while the previous is still running starts after it.

activity.description: Activity name for the logs (contracts/enums/enums.yaml app_activities).

up_bytes.description: kind down: bytes sent up first (request body, LLM context).

delay_ms.description: kind down: server think time before the first byte (LLM time to first token, tool latency).

rate_kbps.description: kind down: pace the response at this rate, like a token stream; what a stall holds back follows in one burst.

chunk_bytes.description: kind down with rate_kbps: bytes per paced write (default 5 ms worth).

AppTrafficFlow.description: App-like background load. The UE's simulated users open TCP connections to the flow's server port and request objects (contracts/packets/app_request.md); both nodes log every object.

dscp_values.description: DSCP values (0–63) to cycle through, one per packet (seq % len). Typical sweep: [0, 8, 16, 40, 46] covers CS0/1/2, AF41, EF.

rate_pps.description: Probe send rate. Lower rates (10 pps) give enough per-DSCP samples without congesting the path.

DscpProbeFlow.description: DSCP transparency probe. UE cycles through dscp_values, marking each uplink packet with the corresponding DSCP. Server reads received DSCP via IP_RECVTOS, marks the echo with dscp_intended_dl, and UE reads the echo's IP TOS to check downlink. Results go into packets.parquet columns dscp_sent and dscp_recv. See contracts/packets/dscp_probe.md for the wire protocol.

ping_interval_ms.description: Probe cadence in ms. Applies to all auto-discovered first-hop targets for this flow.

GatewayPingFlow.description: Logger-only: latency probes to auto-discovered first-hop gateways (rmnet + wlan) during the test window. Probe family: ICMP → UDP(33434) → TCP-SYN(443) → unreachable. Results written to pings.parquet with test_id set. No server endpoint — this flow has no server_port in its FlowBinding.

FlowId.description: Plan-scoped flow identifier. Unique within a TestPlan. Carried verbatim in the wire packet header (u32 on the wire — narrower here for schema sanity). flow_bindings entries reference this.

Port.description: Server-side TCP/UDP port the UE connects to / sends to (invariant 5). Allocated by test-control.

server_port.description: Server-allocated port the UE connects/sends to. Absent for gateway_ping flows (no server endpoint).

FlowBinding.description: Server-allocated binding for one flow. Lives in RunTestPayload / header (not in the plan); referenced to the plan by flow_id. The single source for the binding shape.

UnidirectionalDirection.description: Bidirectional intentionally absent: model bidirectional traffic as two flows.
